tasks.title: Conversation #77
tasks.transcript:
M: Wasn't there supposed to be a yoga class in the conference room at noon today? I stopped in right at noon and no one was there. I was really looking forward to it.
W: Didn't you get the email? The instructor had a personal conflict and had to cancel.
M: When did she send it?
W: I don't know. Maybe quarter after 11?
M: That makes sense. I've been away from my desk since mid morning and haven't checked my email.
W: Then you probably don't know that she is rescheduled for tomorrow.

questions.stem: What did the man do at noon?

options.A: He signed up for a yoga class.
options.B: He entered an empty conference room.
options.C: He read an email sent by the yoga instructor.
options.D: He forwarded an email to the woman.
